content:
nina: Quick triage: onboarding sora-v2 (q5) on staging yields timestamp tokens reversed in vertical JP subtitles when an inline Arabic greeting is present. Repro attached. @kenji @li-wei

kenji: can you paste raw vs outputs?

nina: input:
```
新姐：‎السلام
(下) 08:15
```
fp16 -> "(下) 08:15"
q5 beam=5 -> "(下) 51:80"
q5 beam=1 -> matches fp16.

li-wei: tokenizer ids identical?

nina: yes: [111,222,333,444,555,666]

sam: sounds like score binning+tiebreaker. eval-bot, show top2 beam scores.

_eval-bot:_
```
# fp16: H1 -11.223 H2 -11.300
# q5:  H1 -11.240 H2 -11.239  <-- tiny inversion
```

kenji: actionable: add deterministic lexicographic tie-break for numeric subsequences (hotfix), add regression test in subtitle eval harness, and rerun on Dedicated (to rule out kernel nondet). I'll take the hotfix + dedicated rerun.

li-wei: I'll bisect q5 pack vs runtime tie-change. sam: please file product ticket noting APAC subtitle sensitivity.

nina: added failing sample to qual bucket and PR: internal link. eval-bot: note metrics.

_eval-bot:_ vertical-subset N=7.1k shows q5 -0.48 BLEU vs fp16 concentrated on short numeric spans. Incident logged INC-2031.

kenji: re-run queued on gpu-node-theta with --float-emulate to confirm rounding cause. will report back.
